name: 天蓬蛊
reference_role: 仅卡框、比例、可信光影材质，非身体和背景

evidence.excerpt: 外形，就像是一只大瓢虫。半圆形乳白色的甲壳上，点缀着点点黑斑。

design_boundary: 除证据摘录所锁外观之外，机位、材质细化、具体比例、自然解剖细节及环境布置为美术推断，不新增原著事实、不沿用游戏id转数。
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW 《问真》 Gu portrait collectible card, exact 5:7. Reference image ONLY supplies fine silver double-line rounded-corner frame with restrained curled corners and physical fantasy realism, not its creature, body, color, background or floor. One fully visible specific subject approximately 55-65% card width; clear subject hierarchy, physical sidelight, realistic textures, restful dreamlike space, complete frame on all sides. No text, title, number, rank, watermark, people, hands, halo, gratuitous gems or decorative symbols. Subject: ONE large fist-size LADYBIRD Gu, SEMICIRCULAR MILKY-WHITE domed shell with small BLACK SPOTS scattered on it. Natural squat ladybird body, white living cuticle, black spot texture integrated into shell not holes, six short grounded legs, small dark natural head and tiny antennae, calm unexpressive eyes, not cute toy face. Broad clean smooth white convex back with fine central wing seam, round profile, no jade green or red ladybird coloration. White is softly creamy biological shell, gentle satin highlights and true shading, not faceted crystal, paper folds or porcelain decor. Stand calmly on one plain subdued slate grey dry smooth surface, oblique slightly elevated angle lets milky dome and black spotting show clearly. Empty softly falling dark grey background, no repeated moss flower garden, no shield aura. Natural gentle sidelight, small correct leg contact shadows. Body and structure the focus; no giant eye jewels, name, gold armour, fake shield scales, feathers, normal beetle antlers, fantasy cosmos or illustrative protective spell.

visible_facts: 单只半圆乳白大瓢虫，背甲黑斑，六足与自然小头
无玉色、红色、护盾特效或萌脸，完整细银框
risks: 头、足棕黑色为设计，原著只明确白壳黑斑
壳面细皱较多，不作为原著皮肤肌理事实
